findings.message: The fourth acceptance criterion requires the test to prove that 'every fence path that exists on main is in that seed Context, and every Context path exists on main'. The only pinning criterion covers Context bytes for render sizing; nothing pins the existence set. Checked live, the test is green at authoring time but goes red later. When scheduler-activation merges, `tests/test_daemon_composition.py` will exist on main and sit in that seed's fence, but it cannot be in the seed's Context because the file does not exist when the seed is authored. `uv run pytest -q` then fails for every later ticket. The earlier continuation tests (`tests/test_seeded_phase3_02.py`, `tests/test_seeded_phase3_03.py`, `tests/test_seeded_phase3_core.py`) avoid this by testing against a pinned `EXISTING_AT_AUTHORING` map.
findings.paved_road: Rewrite the criterion so the fence/Context existence closure is checked against a pinned authoring-time `EXISTING_AT_AUTHORING` map, as the prior seeded tests do. That map must include the then-merged `squatch/daemon.py` and any dispatch tests it names. Require `set(context) <= EXISTING_AT_AUTHORING`, and require every fence entry in that map to appear in Context. Never check live existence on main, and keep the same map as the source of the synthetic render sizes.
